==Dialogue==
After completion of The Final Confrontation:
:''"It would seem Zenmai's eye for talent is as sharp as ever. You have helped my friends and my country, hero and for that I give you my thanks. Perhaps there are outsiders worth trusting after all."''

==Notes==
* Daisuke Crimson Edge can be an ally during The Final Confrontation if the player completes [[Zenmai]]'s optional quest [[Redemption for the Lost]]. Similarly he will also be an ally in [[The Final Confrontation (Hard mode)]] if [[Redemption for the Lost (Hard mode)]] has been completed.
